import re

def check_IP(ip):
    pattern = r'^((25[0-5]|2[0-4][0-9]|[01]?[0-9][0-9])\.){3}(25[0-5]|2[0-4][0-9]|[01]?[0-9][0-9])$'
    return 'Valid IP address' if re.match(pattern, ip) else 'Invalid IP address'
```
